title: The Clean Deadline
author: Gideon Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Oyelaran, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
